'''Milsin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Farpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]]. He was the owner of the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].
